notes: Shot at a player in a window. The BB is hidden behind the bush and rail at first and only becomes visible about 0.55 s (below the window), then rises to the player's head, where it hits at 1.233 s (last visible 1.217 s). Times by Claude from zoomed frames, 17/10/2026; user confirmed adding the case. The 3.112 s sound is 0.3 s before the end of the clip and has no visible BB.
